scope: Exact approved trusted backend provisioning/embedding example clauses, isolated local macOS arm64. No installed package, full browser app, provider/media, Linux/remote or acceptance qualification.
implementation: Public ApplicationClient provisioning/issuance creates app/System, Human and Ai identities, native/browser endpoint bindings, verification evidence, public signing keys and scoped credentials. The plan accepts no private signing keys.

The private journal fsyncs each complete original request before IO. Explicit rerun reauthorizes exact saved IDs, revision assertions and absolute expiry. Installation/immutable-plan binding and a private file lock protect rerun.
Each grant has33 explicit current operations and the other2 exact identities. No administrator, wildcard, consent delegation or provider secrets are issued. Revoked/expired resources are not revived.
Protected journal/enrollment files use0600 within private state. Public contacts contain only key, label and Identity ID; native buttons use textContent and immutable selection callbacks.

Runnable canonical embedding uses public configuration/start/owned shutdown, including SIGINT/SIGTERM selection. Administrative/provider configuration remains backend-only; app code opens no Store/Core.
